description: List the open multiplayer rooms of one of the user's own projects (turn rooms on the play server): each room's id, invite code, build, game module, players and seats (connected or not, a test bot or not). No player names or accounts are shown. Use it to find the room a test bot (r3_game_bot) should join. Only the project's owner may list its rooms. Needs the project:read right.
name: r3_game_rooms

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: List a game's open rooms
